Write the general term in the binomial expansion of $\left(3x + \frac{2}{3x^2}\right)^7$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r} (3x)^{7 - r} \left(\frac{2}{3x^2}\right)^r = \binom{7}{r} 3^{7 - r} \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^r x^{7 - 3r}$$

Find the index $r$ for the term in $\frac{1}{x^2} = x^{-2}$:
$$7 - 3r = -2 \implies 3r = 9 \implies r = 3$$

Substitute $r = 3$ to calculate the coefficient:
$$\text{Term} = \binom{7}{3} (3x)^4 \left(\frac{2}{3x^2}\right)^3 = 35 \times 81x^4 \times \frac{8}{27x^6} = 840x^{-2}$$
$$\text{Coefficient of } \frac{1}{x^2} = 840$$
